purpose: Fail-closed control-plane protection. protected_roots governs ACCESS: any matching path is denied to standard-builder tasks, and a new file under a protected root is protected from creation. digest_roots governs DIGEST MEMBERSHIP only and never weakens access. A security-maintenance task may touch only the exact paths named in its owner-issued authority artifact. Covered among the trust-granting and CI-executed surfaces: tools/** (registered validators, liveness gates, supervisor, key tooling), tests/** (CI gates on them), requirements-ci.txt (the sole CI supply-chain input) and .bro/policy.json (selects the operating mode). NOT covered, and stated so that 'in full' is not read into this list: ci/**, install/** and contracts/** are neither protected nor digested, although the monorepo CI runs install/brops_install.sh, ci/live/run_live_turn.sh and ci/live/run_ladder_turn.sh under sudo, and ci/isolation_proof.sh as well; and '.github/workflows/**' matches only this tree's own copy, which GitHub does not run when engine/ is vendored inside menqstudio/OS (the workflows that run live at the monorepo root, outside this manifest's reach). Adding those roots is an owner decision about the perimeter, not an edit to this sentence. Bytecode caches (__pycache__/*.pyc) are excluded from the digest by runtime/bro_protected.py, never listed here.
